localeSwitcher.label: Language
fieldHelp.providers: Each enabled provider checks the domain independently; if even one says "block", the quorum blocks (OR logic). More providers means wider coverage, but more third parties see your queries.
fieldHelp.timeoutMode: How to treat a provider that didn't answer in time. "fail_open" (default) - pass through, treating it as safe; "fail_closed" - block; "degraded" - like fail_open, but explicitly marks the decision as incomplete in the log.
fieldHelp.cache: Min/max lifetime of a cache entry (caps the provider's own TTL), how long to keep a "blocked" verdict, and how many entries the cache holds at once before it starts evicting the oldest.
fieldHelp.overrides: Your own exceptions on top of the quorum: the allowlist always allows, the blocklist always blocks, regardless of what the providers say. On conflict between the two lists, the allowlist wins.
fieldHelp.logFilters: Search and filters only act within the current log window - the last ~1000 queries or 24 hours; older entries are no longer kept.

app.queryLogPersistWarning: The query log is saved to disk in an encrypted file (query-log.enc) - this keeps browsing history across restarts. To disable: persist_query_log = false in resolver_config.toml.
app.cachePersistWarning: The verdict cache is saved to disk in an encrypted file (cache.enc) - which domains were resolved is kept across restarts. To disable: persist_cache = false in resolver_config.toml.
app.personalZonePersistWarning: The rating filter's personal learned zone is saved to disk in an encrypted file (personal-zone.enc) - this remembers which sites you visit often/regularly. To disable: [personal_zone] enabled = false in resolver_config.toml.
warning.notPersisted: The change was applied but NOT saved to disk - it will not survive a service restart.

cctldBlock.heading: ccTLD block
cctldBlock.description: Blocks the whole domain if it ends in the chosen TLD code (e.g. .ru).
cctldBlock.overBlockingWarning: Blocking by ccTLD catches every domain under that suffix - regardless of who actually runs the site or where its content is hosted. Many legitimate sites register under a TLD that doesn't match their own jurisdiction (e.g. .io/.co) for reasons unrelated to it.
cctldBlock.inputPlaceholder: Add a code - country or code (e.g. ru)…

geoip.noDatabaseStatus: The GeoIP database isn't loaded yet - country filtering isn't in effect right now, regardless of the list below.
geoip.unknownBuildDateStatus: The GeoIP database is loaded; its build date is unknown.
geoip.overBlockingWarning: Large CDNs (Cloudflare, Google, Amazon) hand out anycast addresses whose apparent geography changes between requests - blocking a country risks blocking legitimate sites that simply route through a data center in that country, with no actual tie to its jurisdiction.

browserSetup.heading: Connect your browser
browserSetup.intro: Enter this address as the "custom DNS provider" in your browser settings:
browserSetup.chromium.step1: Open a new tab and paste into the address bar (links to chrome:// pages from a web page don't work - manual only):
browserSetup.chromium.step2: "Use secure DNS" → "Custom" → paste the address from above.
browserSetup.firefox.step1: Open a new tab and paste into the address bar:
browserSetup.firefox.step2: Section "DNS over HTTPS" → "Max Protection" → "Choose provider" → "Custom" → paste the address from above.
browserSetup.other.step1: In your browser settings find "DNS over HTTPS" / "Secure DNS" / "Custom DNS provider".
browserSetup.other.step2: Choose the "Custom" mode and paste the address from above.
browserSetup.verify: Check: open any site - a row with ALLOWED should appear in the log below. That the browser really resolves through this service is verified separately: block a domain and open it, you should get ERR_ADDRESS_INVALID (not ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED); the full procedure is in the README, section "Перевірка: браузер → локальний DoH" (Ukrainian).
danger.heading: Full removal
danger.warning: Removes the local trusted dns-quorum-filter certificate and all stored keys/credentials (TLS key, the log/cache encryption key, MaxMind credentials if any) from the Windows credential store. This does not remove the app itself or clear its data folder - for a full removal (stop the app + wipe the whole data folder + Windows Settings) use the "Fully remove" item in the tray icon menu.

rating.heading: Rating filter "bubble"
rating.title: Restrict the internet to chosen zones
rating.desc.active: Active. Outside the chosen zones → block, the quorum isn't queried.
rating.desc.enabled: Only allows resolving sites from curated lists of popular domains. Everything else → block.
rating.desc.off: Only allows resolving sites from curated lists of popular domains. Everything else → block. Optional, off by default. Pick zones in advance - they apply as soon as you turn it on.
rating.forkBWarning: The filter is on, but no list has been downloaded yet - filtering isn't in effect for now. It will update automatically in a few seconds.
rating.confirmNotice: Turning this on will block the vast majority of the internet - only sites from the zones chosen below will remain reachable. Off by default.
rating.offlineMessage: No internet connection - the zone lists can't be downloaded.
rating.inputPlaceholder: Add a zone - a country or "global top"…
blocklist.heading: Blocklist bundles
blocklist.title: Block using public bundle lists
blocklist.desc.off: Supplements the quorum with static public lists (ads/trackers/malware/DGA). Optional, off by default. Same pipeline, step 2 only (Blocklist).
blocklist.emptyNotice.active: Turned on, but no source is selected - blocking still applies to the previously loaded set (it isn't cleared automatically until you select a source).
blocklist.emptyNotice.inactive: Turned on, but no source is selected - filtering isn't in effect. Tick at least one source below.
blocklist.forkBNotice: Turned on, the first download is running in the background - the previous (empty) version stays in effect. Refresh the page to see the result once it finishes.
blocklist.orphanDesc: unknown source (no longer published) - untick it to save your other changes
blocklist.status.unchecked: unticked - stays in effect until the next refresh
blocklist.source.hageziMultiPro.desc: Ads, trackers, malware - the main set
blocklist.source.adguardDnsFilter.desc: Same class, a separate source - wider coverage
blocklist.source.oneHostsLite.desc: Same again, a lighter list - fewer false blocks
blocklist.source.hageziNrdDga.desc: Newly registered and algorithmically generated domains (malware C2)
